item.text: {"issues":[{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Reports describe removed or changed features and a degraded interface after updates, with one separate Android Auto voice command issue.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["1989f316-e407-475e-9a0b-49ce8021edcc"],"issue_id":"TMP_USABILITY_02_B","issue_name":"Update-related feature and interface changes"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"yes","description":"Music playback stops, pauses, or fails to start, sometimes requiring users to restart the app, switch tracks, or reinstall it.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_01+TMP_PLAYBACK_03_A","issue_name":"Playback stops or fails"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Reports describe songs failing to play as selected, unexpected track choices or repetition, and playback advancing or becoming silent.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["a61a3796-d426-45fa-b83e-f22510faa00f"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_01+TMP_PLAYBACK_03_B","issue_name":"Unexpected song selection and playback"},{"actionable":"no","coherent":"no","description":"Most examples express general dislike without a specific download problem; one reports the app appearing offline while the user is connected.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["0f8538c6-fa86-41f9-be25-bf49b8caa427"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01_A","issue_name":"Vague negative reactions to the app"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Reports describe downloads that fail, take too long, or disappear or save to the wrong storage location.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["8d175a0c-d1a1-477e-a97c-443050e41720","f53692ce-99f7-4818-8774-f1cdd0a56026"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01_B","issue_name":"Download failures and storage issues"}]}
